fn tri_tag(t: Tri) -> Str = match t {
  Tri::True => "T",
  Tri::False => "F",
  Tri::Unknown => "U",
}

fn main!() -> Res[Str, Str] {
  let nots = concat([tri_tag(Tri::True.not()), tri_tag(Tri::False.not()), tri_tag(Tri::Unknown.not())])
  let ands = concat([
    tri_tag(Tri::True.and(Tri::True)),
    tri_tag(Tri::True.and(Tri::False)),
    tri_tag(Tri::True.and(Tri::Unknown)),
    tri_tag(Tri::False.and(Tri::True)),
    tri_tag(Tri::False.and(Tri::False)),
    tri_tag(Tri::False.and(Tri::Unknown)),
    tri_tag(Tri::Unknown.and(Tri::True)),
    tri_tag(Tri::Unknown.and(Tri::False)),
    tri_tag(Tri::Unknown.and(Tri::Unknown)),
  ])
  let ors = concat([
    tri_tag(Tri::True.or(Tri::True)),
    tri_tag(Tri::True.or(Tri::False)),
    tri_tag(Tri::True.or(Tri::Unknown)),
    tri_tag(Tri::False.or(Tri::True)),
    tri_tag(Tri::False.or(Tri::False)),
    tri_tag(Tri::False.or(Tri::Unknown)),
    tri_tag(Tri::Unknown.or(Tri::True)),
    tri_tag(Tri::Unknown.or(Tri::False)),
    tri_tag(Tri::Unknown.or(Tri::Unknown)),
  ])
  yield Ok(concat([nots, "|", ands, "|", ors]))
}

import std::map::Map

fn main!() -> Res[Str, Str] {
  let nan: f64 = 0.0 /. 0.0
  let negative_zero: f64 = -0.0

    .insert(negative_zero, "negative")
    .insert(positive_zero, "positive")

import std::tensor::{AxisError, DTypeError, NumericError, ShapeError, Tensor, ones, zeros}

fn is_f32_tensor(_x: Tensor[f32]) -> Bool = true
fn is_i32_tensor(_x: Tensor[i32]) -> Bool = true

fn main!() -> Res[Str, Union[AxisError, DTypeError, NumericError, ShapeError]] =
  result {
    let float_view = permute(ones[f32](2,3), [#1, #0].to_vec())?
    let condition_view = permute(zeros[bool](2,3), [#1, #0].to_vec())?
    let unary = exp(float_view)?
    let binary_left = add(float_view, ones[f32](3,2))?
    let binary_right = add(ones[f32](3,2), float_view)?
    let conditional = where(condition_view, ones[f32](3,2), float_view)?
    let integer_view = permute(ones[i32](2,3), [#1, #0].to_vec())?
    let wrapping_left = wrapping_add(integer_view, ones[i32](3,2))?
    let wrapping_right = wrapping_add(ones[i32](3,2), integer_view)?
    let ok = (is_f32_tensor(unary)
      && is_f32_tensor(binary_left)
      && is_f32_tensor(binary_right)
      && is_f32_tensor(conditional)
      && is_i32_tensor(wrapping_left)
      && is_i32_tensor(wrapping_right))
    yield Ok(to_str(ok))
  }

import std::tensor::{DTypeError, DeterminismError, IndexError, ShapeError, ones, zeros}
import std::tensor::index::{get_at, set_at, IndexItem, ScatterMode}
import std::tensor::prim::slice

fn main!() -> Res[Str, Union[IndexError, ShapeError, DTypeError, DeterminismError]] =
  result {
    let marked = set_at(zeros[f32](5), [IndexItem::Take([0])].to_vec(), ones[f32](1), mode=ScatterMode::Assign)?
    let reversed = get_at(marked, [IndexItem::Slice(None, None, -1)].to_vec())?
    let first = get_at(reversed, [IndexItem::At(0)].to_vec())?.item()?
    let last = get_at(reversed, [IndexItem::At(-1)].to_vec())?.item()?
    let taken = get_at(marked, [IndexItem::Take([-5])].to_vec())?
    let taken_value = get_at(taken, [IndexItem::At(0)].to_vec())?.item()?
    let scattered = set_at(zeros[f32](5), [IndexItem::Slice(None, None, -1)].to_vec(), marked, mode=ScatterMode::Assign)?
    let scattered_last = get_at(scattered, [IndexItem::At(-1)].to_vec())?.item()?
    let empty_scatter = set_at(scattered, [IndexItem::Slice(4, 1, 1)].to_vec(), zeros[f32](0), mode=ScatterMode::Assign)?
    let after_empty_scatter = get_at(empty_scatter, [IndexItem::At(-1)].to_vec())?.item()?

    let clipped = slice(zeros[f32](5), [IndexItem::Slice(-99, 99, 2)].to_vec())?
    let explicit_neg_one = slice(zeros[f32](5), [IndexItem::Slice(None, -1, -1)].to_vec())?
    let empty_reverse = slice(zeros[f32](0), [IndexItem::Slice(None, None, -1)].to_vec())?

    let min_i64 = wrapping_sub(-9223372036854775807, 1)
    let min_bound = slice(zeros[f32](5), [IndexItem::Slice(min_i64, None, 1)].to_vec())?
    let min_step = slice(zeros[f32](5), [IndexItem::Slice(None, None, min_i64)].to_vec())?

    let ok = ((first == 0.0)
      && (last == 1.0)
      && (taken_value == 1.0)
      && (scattered_last == 1.0)
      && (after_empty_scatter == 1.0)
      && (to_str(clipped.shape()) == "[3]")
      && (to_str(explicit_neg_one.shape()) == "[0]")
      && (to_str(empty_reverse.shape()) == "[0]")
      && (to_str(min_bound.shape()) == "[5]")
      && (to_str(min_step.shape()) == "[1]"))
    yield Ok(to_str(ok))
  }

    let source = slice(ones[f32](2,3), [IndexItem::All, IndexItem::All].to_vec())?
    let permuted = permute(source, [#1, #0].to_vec())?
    let reshaped = reshape(source, [6].to_vec())?
    let unsqueezed = unsqueeze(source, #0)?

    let expandable = slice(ones[f32](1,3), [IndexItem::All, IndexItem::All].to_vec())?
    let expanded = expand(expandable, [2,3].to_vec())?
    let sliced = slice(source, [IndexItem::All, IndexItem::Slice(0, 2)].to_vec())?

      && is_view(reshaped)
      && is_view(unsqueezed)
      && is_view(squeezed)
      && is_view(expanded)
      && is_view(sliced)

      && (to_str(expanded.shape()) == "[2,3]")
      && (to_str(sliced.shape()) == "[2,2]"))

fn main!() -> Res[Str, Union[DTypeError, IndexError, NumericError, ShapeError]] =
  result {
    let one = ones[i8]()
    let two = add(one, one)?
    let three = add(two, one)?
    let six = add(three, three)?

    let neg_seven = neg(seven)?

    let neg_pos_r = rem(neg_seven, three)?.item()?

import std::tensor::{DTypeError, IndexError, NumericError, ShapeError, ones, zeros}
import std::tensor::prim::{add, div, exp, log, neg, sqrt, tanh}

fn main!() -> Res[Str, Union[DTypeError, IndexError, NumericError, ShapeError]] =
  result {
    let one = ones[f32]()
    let positive_zero_tensor = zeros[f32]()
    let negative_zero_tensor = neg(positive_zero_tensor)?
    let negative_one_tensor = neg(one)?
    let positive_infinity_tensor = div(one, positive_zero_tensor)?
    let negative_infinity_tensor = neg(positive_infinity_tensor)?
    let nan_tensor = div(positive_zero_tensor, positive_zero_tensor)?

    let two = add(one, one)?
    let four = add(two, two)?
    let eight = add(four, four)?
    let sixteen = add(eight, eight)?
    let thirty_two = add(sixteen, sixteen)?
    let sixty_four = add(thirty_two, thirty_two)?
    let one_twenty_eight = add(sixty_four, sixty_four)?

    let positive_zero = positive_zero_tensor.item()?
    let negative_zero = negative_zero_tensor.item()?
    let positive_one = one.item()?
    let negative_one = negative_one_tensor.item()?
    let positive_infinity = positive_infinity_tensor.item()?
    let negative_infinity = negative_infinity_tensor.item()?

    let log_negative = log(negative_one_tensor)?.item()?
    let log_negative_infinity = log(negative_infinity_tensor)?.item()?
    let sqrt_negative = sqrt(negative_one_tensor)?.item()?
    let sqrt_negative_infinity = sqrt(negative_infinity_tensor)?.item()?

    // Eglur's float total order places every NaN above positive infinity.
    let ok = ((exp(positive_infinity_tensor)?.item()? == positive_infinity)
      && (exp(negative_infinity_tensor)?.item()? == positive_zero)
      && (exp(one_twenty_eight)?.item()? == positive_infinity)
      && (log(positive_infinity_tensor)?.item()? == positive_infinity)
      && (log(positive_zero_tensor)?.item()? == negative_infinity)
      && (log(negative_zero_tensor)?.item()? == negative_infinity)
      && (log_negative > positive_infinity)
      && (log_negative_infinity > positive_infinity)
      && (sqrt(positive_infinity_tensor)?.item()? == positive_infinity)
      && (sqrt(positive_zero_tensor)?.item()? == positive_zero)
      && (sqrt(negative_zero_tensor)?.item()? == negative_zero)
      && (sqrt_negative > positive_infinity)
      && (sqrt_negative_infinity > positive_infinity)
      && (tanh(positive_infinity_tensor)?.item()? == positive_one)
      && (tanh(negative_infinity_tensor)?.item()? == negative_one)
      && (tanh(positive_zero_tensor)?.item()? == positive_zero)
      && (tanh(negative_zero_tensor)?.item()? == negative_zero)
      && (exp(nan_tensor)?.item()? > positive_infinity)
      && (log(nan_tensor)?.item()? > positive_infinity)
      && (sqrt(nan_tensor)?.item()? > positive_infinity)
      && (tanh(nan_tensor)?.item()? > positive_infinity))
    yield Ok(to_str(ok))
  }

import std::tensor::{AxisError, AxisSel, DTypeError, DeterminismError, IndexError, NumericError, ShapeError, Tensor, ones, zeros}
import std::tensor::index::{get_at, set_at, IndexItem, ScatterMode}
import std::tensor::prim::{max, mean, sum}
import std::vec::Vec

fn is_tensor(_x: Tensor[f32]) -> Bool = true

fn main!() -> Res[Str, Union[AxisError, DTypeError, DeterminismError, IndexError, NumericError, ShapeError]] =
  result {
    let marked = set_at(
      zeros[f32](2,3),
      [IndexItem::At(1), IndexItem::At(2)].to_vec(),
      ones[f32](),
      mode=ScatterMode::Assign,
    )?
    let x = marked.with_names([#0:'batch, #1:'feature])?
    let no_axes = Vec[AxisSel].new()
    let summed = sum(x, no_axes, keepdims=true)?
    let maximum = max(x, no_axes, keepdims=true)?
    let average = mean(x, no_axes, keepdims=true)?
    let marked_coordinate = [IndexItem::At(1), IndexItem::At(2)].to_vec()
    let zero_coordinate = [IndexItem::At(0), IndexItem::At(0)].to_vec()
    let ok = (is_tensor(summed)
      && is_tensor(maximum)
      && is_tensor(average)
      && (to_str(summed.shape()) == "[2,3]")
      && (to_str(maximum.shape()) == "[2,3]")
      && (to_str(average.shape()) == "[2,3]")
      && (to_str(summed.dtype()) == "f32")
      && (to_str(maximum.dtype()) == "f32")
      && (to_str(average.dtype()) == "f32")
      && (summed.names().len() == 2)
      && (maximum.names().len() == 2)
      && (average.names().len() == 2)
      && (summed.axis_of('batch)? == #0)
      && (summed.axis_of('feature)? == #1)
      && (maximum.axis_of('batch)? == #0)
      && (maximum.axis_of('feature)? == #1)
      && (average.axis_of('batch)? == #0)
      && (average.axis_of('feature)? == #1)
      && (get_at(summed, marked_coordinate)?.item()? == 1.0)
      && (get_at(maximum, marked_coordinate)?.item()? == 1.0)
      && (get_at(average, marked_coordinate)?.item()? == 1.0)
      && (get_at(summed, zero_coordinate)?.item()? == 0.0)
      && (get_at(maximum, zero_coordinate)?.item()? == 0.0)
      && (get_at(average, zero_coordinate)?.item()? == 0.0))
    yield Ok(to_str(ok))
  }
